axes.name: Amass
axes.definition: Amassing Goblins: creating a Goblin Army token or putting +1/+1 counters on your Army or other Goblins.

axes.name: Goblins
axes.definition: Goblin creatures you control, including the Goblin Army token that amass creates.

axes.name: Sacrifice fodder
axes.definition: Permanents you are happy to sacrifice to an outlet: creature tokens, Treasures, cheap creatures and creatures with dies triggers.

axes.name: Creature deaths
axes.definition: Making creatures die: sacrifice outlets, edicts, creatures that trade or chump freely, and removal that destroys rather than exiles.

axes.name: Tokens
axes.definition: Creating tokens of any kind under your control: creature tokens, Treasures, Equipment tokens and Goblin Armies.

axes.name: Board width
axes.definition: Having many creatures on the battlefield at once: cheap creatures, token makers and creatures that bring a second body.

axes.name: Treasures
axes.definition: Creating Treasure tokens and keeping them around for Treasure-count and Treasure-mana payoffs.

axes.name: Artifacts
axes.definition: Artifacts entering or staying under your control: Equipment, Treasures, Vehicles, other artifacts and artifact tokens.

axes.name: Storied
axes.definition: Permanents that count toward storied's enduring story: artifacts, legendary permanents and Sagas you control.

axes.name: Equipment
axes.definition: Equipment you control: Equipment cards and Equipment tokens to attach, re-attach, count and put hone counters on.

axes.name: Dwarves
axes.definition: Dwarf creatures you control or that enter under your control, including 2/2 Dwarf tokens.

axes.name: Elves
axes.definition: Elf creatures you control, including Elf tokens, and Elf cards in your hand or graveyard.

axes.name: Wolves
axes.definition: Wolf creatures you control, including 2/2 Wolf tokens.

axes.name: Bears
axes.definition: Bear creatures you control, including Bear tokens and creatures that become Bears.

axes.name: Ferocious
axes.definition: Controlling a creature with power 4 or greater, by printed power, counters or pump, to turn on ferocious.

axes.name: Landfall
axes.definition: Lands entering under your control: land drops, extra land drops, lands fetched onto the battlefield, and lands bounced or flickered to replay.

axes.name: Second card drawn
axes.definition: Drawing a second card in a turn on your own turn: recruit, looting, cantrips, draw-two spells and repeatable draw.

axes.name: Graveyard
axes.definition: Filling your own graveyard: recruit and loot discards, self-mill, cycling and creature cards that die, so threshold, recursion and cast-from-graveyard cards have fuel.

axes.name: Noncreature spells
axes.definition: Casting noncreature spells: instants, sorceries, enchantments, artifacts and the Adventure halves of adventurer cards.

axes.name: Enters triggers
axes.definition: Permanents with enters-the-battlefield triggers that pay off again when bounced, flickered, reanimated or recast.

corrections.reason: First mode destroys a creature with power 4 or greater, so it makes a creature die rather than exiling it.
Second mode makes a creature an artifact until end of turn, which can push you to three artifacts/legendaries/Sagas and storied's enduring story lasts for the rest of the game.
Second mode gives all of a player's creatures -1/-1, killing 1-toughness creatures and tokens; it is already partnered with Supper for Spiders on that basis.
Enters trigger draws a card on your own turn, the same reason Bilbo Baggins, Burglar carries second-draw enabler 1.
A 4/4 body turns on ferocious; every other printed 4-power creature in the set carries this role.
Discarding your hand to draw that many cards on a Dwarf entering draws two or more on your own turn.
Ferocious only checks that you control a creature with power 4 or greater; a tapped 5-power body for three mana still turns it on every turn, so not untapping does not weaken it.
Dain's Axe token is an Equipment entering under your control, which triggers Kili's draw; Iron Hills Blacksmith is partnered with Kili for the same reason.
Easy Pickings deals 1 damage to each opposing creature, killing 1-toughness creatures and tokens; it is already partnered with Supper for Spiders on that basis.
Its {1}, {T}, discard: draw ability is a repeatable loot on your own turn; Thror's Map carries second-draw enabler 1 for the same ability.
Spew Flame deals 5 damage to target creature, the same effect Magnificent End carries creature-deaths enabler 1 for.
Drawing two cards at the beginning of combat on your turn when you control three Bears is a second draw on your own turn.
Bite removal kills the opposing creature with damage rather than exile, like Magnificent End.
Fight removal kills the opposing creature with damage rather than exile, like Magnificent End.
First mode destroys a creature with flying, conditional destroy removal like Stone by Sunlight.
{T}, Sacrifice another Goblin is a sacrifice outlet for the Goblin Army token and Fearsome Goblin Pair, which it is already partnered with.
Drawing a card whenever you attack while ferocious is repeatable draw on your own turn; Rage into the Valley carries second-draw enabler 1 for a single draw.
Its enters trigger can put the +1/+1 counter on itself, making a 4/2 Wolf for three mana in the ferocious colours.
Bouncing a permanent on entering puts a +1/+1 counter on it, making it a 4/3; Mirkwood Meditator carries ferocious enabler 1 for a similar conditional 4-power.
Its enters trigger is a loot (draw, then discard) on your own turn, the same reason Bilbo, Luckwearer carries second-draw enabler 1.
A 5/6 for five mana in black and green turns on ferocious, the same as Beorn, Reluctant Host at strength 2.
Drawing two cards whenever another legendary Elf enters is a second draw on your own turn.
Every activation discards a card after drawing, filling your graveyard; Bilbo, Luckwearer carries graveyard enabler 1 for its loot.
